actions.reason: S1 has an interpretable immune/inflammatory transcriptomic identity (ER:a4f3226b98ca:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:4fac32ffe4), but its exact-set membership is broadly unsupported: three of four native geometries are negative (CT -0.056, WSI -0.114, WXS -0.040) and place S1 nearest to K3_C0003 rather than S2 (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:4fac32ffe4). Its boundaries are weak and merge-compatible: S1-S2 shows only small silhouettes (0.020-0.125) with high normalized-cut cost (0.641) and a single-cluster-dominated union (candidate_k=1) (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:09956734ff; ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:09956734ff), and S1-K3_C0003 is weak and materially uneven with CT/WXS near zero (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:b591229ca5; ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:b591229ca5). Membership is also significantly associated with multiple technical/acquisition factors (tissue source site 0.574, CT manufacturer 0.333, scanner model 0.352, reconstruction kernel 0.337), which remain plausible alternative explanations (ER:a4f3226b98ca:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:4fac32ffe4). WXS mutation evidence is directionally coherent but multiplicity-nonsignificant (ER:a4f3226b98ca:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:4fac32ffe4). With unsupported membership, weak/merge-compatible boundaries, and unresolved technical alternatives, S1 lacks defensible independent discovery value.

S2 has an interpretable metabolic/biosynthetic transcriptomic identity (ER:a4f3226b98ca:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:a07ccf1da6), but its exact-set membership is broadly unsupported: three of four native geometries are negative (RNA -0.060, WSI -0.093, WXS -0.097) with high negative fractions (0.667-0.810), and three views place S2 nearest to K3_C0003 (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:a07ccf1da6). Its boundaries are weak and merge-compatible: S2-K3_C0003 shows uniformly small silhouettes (0.043-0.082) with WSI median at zero and negative fraction 0.514 (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:7765f2812a), and S1-S2 is weak with a single-cluster-dominated union (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:pair:09956734ff; ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:09956734ff). Membership is significantly associated with nearly every measured technical/acquisition factor (tissue source site 0.688, CT manufacturer 0.590, scanner model 0.558, reconstruction kernel 0.561, slice thickness 0.379, z-spacing 0.389, CT phase 0.391), which remain strong plausible alternative explanations (ER:a4f3226b98ca:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:a07ccf1da6). WXS mutation evidence is directionally coherent but only VHL survives panel FDR and none survives global FDR (ER:a4f3226b98ca:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:a07ccf1da6). With unsupported membership, weak/merge-compatible boundaries, and unresolved technical alternatives, S2 lacks defensible independent discovery value.

K3_C0003 has a substantive, interpretable biological identity: a coherent transcriptomic phenotype with broadly down-regulated immune/inflammatory programs and concordant HLA/T-cell leading-edge genes (ER:a4f3226b98ca:biological_support:rna_pathway_enrichment:set:c3d03e2c9e), supported by a directionally coherent mutation profile (PBRM1 OR 3.72, VHL OR 2.71, BAP1 depletion) (ER:a4f3226b98ca:biological_support:wxs_mutation_enrichment:set:c3d03e2c9e). Unlike S1 and S2, its membership is coherently represented: all four native geometries agree in direction with positive silhouettes (CT 0.032, RNA 0.091, WSI 0.301, WXS 0.095) (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:affinity_geometry_concordance:set:c3d03e2c9e). Its relevant neighboring boundaries are the strongest of the partition: S2-K3_C0003 has the highest within-side affinity (0.599), lowest between-side affinity (0.217), lowest normalized-cut cost (0.540), and high spectral agreement (ARI 0.887) (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:7765f2812a), and S1-K3_C0003 shows high spectral agreement (ARI 0.810) with intermediate normalized-cut cost (0.594) (ER:a4f3226b98ca:cross_modal_consistency:structural_diagnostics:pair:b591229ca5). Technical associations exist (tissue source site 0.456, CT phase 0.313) but are fewer and weaker than for S1/S2, and no measured factor is shown to explain the coherent cross-modal membership (ER:a4f3226b98ca:confounder_exclusion:confounder_association:set:c3d03e2c9e). K3_C0003 therefore remains an independent discovery-stage unit.
